title: Formulary Structure and Utilisation Controls of the Ridgecrest RxSecure Plans
content:
Each Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan uses one CMS formulary, of the number of cost-share tiers this schedule gives, and enforces prior authorisation, step therapy and quantity limits only on the tiers and terms recorded here. The transition terms and the refill and opioid safety thresholds belong to the plan in the same way.

| Plan | Cost-share tiers on the formulary | CMS formulary identifier | Tiers on which prior authorisation is enforced | Tiers on which step therapy is enforced | Quantity limits enforced at the point of sale |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Basic (PDP) | 5 | 00026731 | tier 3 preferred brand, tier 4 non-preferred drug, tier 5 specialty | tier 3 preferred brand, tier 4 non-preferred drug | yes |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Value (PDP) | 5 | 00026732 | tier 3 preferred brand, tier 4 non-preferred drug, tier 5 specialty | tier 3 preferred brand, tier 4 non-preferred drug | yes |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Select (PDP) | 5 | 00026733 | tier 4 non-preferred drug, tier 5 specialty | tier 4 non-preferred drug | yes |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Plus (PDP) | 6 | 00026734 | tier 4 non-preferred drug, tier 5 specialty | tier 4 non-preferred drug | yes |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Complete (PDP) | 6 | 00026735 | tier 5 specialty | none | yes |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Premier (PDP) | 6 | 00026736 | tier 5 specialty | none | no |

| Plan | Transition supply (days) | Transition fills allowed in the first ninety days | Previous days supply that must be used before a refill (per cent) | Daily morphine milligram equivalent at which the opioid safety edit fires |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Basic (PDP) | 30 | 1 | 75 | 90 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Value (PDP) | 30 | 1 | 75 | 90 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Select (PDP) | 30 | 1 | 75 | 90 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Plus (PDP) | 31 | 2 | 70 | 90 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Complete (PDP) | 31 | 2 | 70 | 90 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Premier (PDP) | 31 | 3 | 70 | 90 |

## Points of judgement

- The three lower plans carry five cost-share tiers and the three higher plans six; every plan uses its own CMS formulary identifier, and no two plans share one.
- Ridgecrest RxSecure Complete (PDP) and Premier (PDP) enforce step therapy on no tier at all, and Ridgecrest RxSecure Premier (PDP) enforces no quantity limits at the point of sale.
- The opioid safety edit fires at a daily morphine milligram equivalent of 90 on all six plans; the refill threshold does move, standing at 75 per cent on the three lower plans and 70 per cent on the three higher ones.
